description: Upgrade winget packages immediately (on-demand, outside Puppet agent runs). Upgrades the given IDs, or every package with an available upgrade when `ids` is empty.

ids.description: Winget IDs to upgrade. When empty, every package with an available upgrade is processed (minus `exclude`).

exclude.description: Winget IDs to skip (case-insensitive). Only used when `ids` is empty.

include_pinned.description: Also upgrade pinned packages when enumerating all upgrades. Explicit `ids` are always upgraded (a blocking pin still fails the package).
